description:
## Scope and owner
Planning only. Add tests exclusively to test/zaq_web/live/bo/ai/ingestion_progress_test.exs for uncovered lines 100, 108 and 110 of lib/zaq_web/components/design_system/ingestion_progress.ex. Keep existing use ZaqWeb.ConnCase, async: true, import Phoenix.LiveViewTest and alias IngestionProgress. Preserve all existing assertions. No changes to component, production APIs, support, CSS, stories, LiveViews, or E2E. Baseline uncovered lines were supplied, not remeasured. Line numbers checked against live source. Related feature issue zaq-60a.5 already owns multilingual ingestion UI; this is a distinct narrow test-only follow-up and need not block it.

## Functional specifications covered with associated files
Production component public contract ingestion_progress/1 renders a positive-total summary with a progressbar, accessible count text, percentage segments, language chips, and optional errors. Existing test file already tests normal English/Japanese/French and native/parade/legacy backend labels and empty/missing totals. Missing branches: clamp/3 fallback at line 100 converts a noninteger count to lower bound; language_label/1 line 108 converts literal simple to Undetermined; line 110 converts any other nonbinary language to Undetermined. Keep data shape realistic for a persisted legacy or malformed summary; do not alter business operations.

## Tests to add before implementation; branches and observables
1. In the existing test file add a component test for malformed indexed count: render summary with total_chunks_detected 10, total_chunks_indexed nil or a nonnumeric string, total_chunks_simple_indexed 3. Since indexed is clamped to zero and simple cannot exceed indexed, assert role=progressbar, aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=10, aria-valuenow=0, aria-valuetext=0 language-specific, 0 language-neutral indexing, 10 unindexed out of 10; exact visible 0/0/10 counts and 0.0%, 0.0%, 100.0% segment labels/widths. Do not confuse this with absent indexed count: absent defaults to integer 0 and misses line 100. Also render a separate summary total 10, indexed 7, simple_indexed noninteger such as unknown; assert aria-valuenow=7, specific 7, simple 0, unindexed 3 and corresponding 70.0%, 0.0%, 30.0%. This exercises line 100 for each independently sourced metric without altering positive-total guard. Use Floki.find on returned HTML for the progressbar/segments and labels, or focused existing HTML assertions; assert exact outputs, not mere presence. Avoid errors/languages in this test unless relevant.
2. Add a component test rendering positive total 4, indexed 4, simple_indexed 1, detected_languages [simple, english, nil, 42] as string values simple and english plus nil/integer. Parse zaq-ingestion-progress__language spans in order with Floki.text: expect [Undetermined, English, Undetermined, Undetermined]. Assert Detected languages wrapper exists and four chips render; the literal simple covers line 108, nil and 42 each cover line 110, and English ensures valid binary values remain capitalized. Negative malformed values are presentation fallback, not language-identifier validation. Optionally split literal simple and malformed entries into two tests to make branches unmistakable; keep specific inputs visible.
3. Consider one bounded ExUnitProperties/StreamData property if adding broad clamp coverage: generate positive totals 1..100, indexed and simple numeric counters in -100..200 OR a small set of malformed values; for each render and assert 0 <= aria-valuenow <= total, nonnegative count labels, specific + simple + unindexed = total, and percentages/segment widths in 0..100. Avoid copying clamp implementation into expected values and keep deterministic examples above for exact regression behavior. As the target is three finite fallback branches, a property is optional only if the added test contract asserts broad-input clamping as an invariant; if omitted, document that focused examples are sufficient and no new invariant logic was introduced.

## Isolation and mocking
Component rendering is synchronous and pure, no database writes, external calls, process signals, timers, or global mutation. Retain async: true; reuse render_component/2, existing module imports/alias, Floki if focused DOM assertions help. No mocks, Mox, factories, configuration mutation, subscriptions, sleeps, polling, or new production seams. No spawned process or observable-event synchronization needed.

## Action reuse assessment
Not applicable: tests only exercise the existing presentation contract, do not add/change/orchestrate any executable operation, Action, domain API, or agent tool. Reuse IngestionProgress.ingestion_progress/1 itself. No new action exposure or NodeRouter call.

## E2E, docs and execution handoff
No new feature or user journey: component-level coverage is sufficient; no new E2E authoring or human UX approval required for this test-only scope. Existing ingestion E2E is unaffected. No documentation edits; record results in this Beadwork issue. During implementation: add tests first, run isolated mix test test/zaq_web/live/bo/ai/ingestion_progress_test.exs and issue-level mix q through Context Mode; later coordinator handles requested coverage and final lifecycle gates per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, not this planning session. Do not run full suite or gates here. Check target lines and HTML expectations against current checkout before implementing; never weaken existing assertions. Dependencies: no new step prerequisite; single test-owner issue.

comments.text: Implemented focused test-only coverage in test/zaq_web/live/bo/ai/ingestion_progress_test.exs: malformed indexed/simple counts assert accessible count text, exact labels, percentages and widths; simple/nil/integer language values assert ordered fallback labels. As requested, no tests/formatting/validation run; awaiting coordinator isolated validation.
